description: Anchor totality and collision confluence. A leading punctuation heading collapses to a leading hyphen and MUST be trimmed, or the anchor it produces could never be the target of a link (link_target requires [a-z0-9] first). A heading with no ASCII letters or digits produces the empty string and becomes section-<n>, numbered over the empty ones in document order. A duplicate takes -2, then re-checks: a-2 already exists naturally, so the duplicate takes the next free suffix a-3.
